name: Sophia University
description: Sophia University is a private Jesuit university in central Tokyo (Yotsuya), founded in 1913. It teaches undergraduate degrees in English through its Faculty of Liberal Arts and the Sophia Program for Sustainable Futures (SPSF).
whyIncluded: Sophia's English-taught undergraduate programmes accept GCE A-Level or IB Diploma results as an alternative to SAT or ACT scores.

livingCosts.summary: Sophia's own monthly living-expense guide for international students in Tokyo (meals, commuting, personal spending, textbooks and health insurance) plus its own international house rent with utilities included, 12 months a year. Sophia suggests about 150,000 a month overall.
livingCosts.notes: Rung A. Sophia University Web Piloti 'Living Expenses' page for international students (undated, read 2026-10-08; says to prepare approx. 150,000 JPY per month): food = meals 30,000-60,000 (midpoint 45,000); transport = commuter pass 5,000-10,000 (midpoint 7,500); personal = personal expenses 20,000 + Japanese National Health Insurance 1,500-3,000 (midpoint 2,250) + textbooks 30,000-50,000 per semester (midpoint 40,000 / 6 months = 6,666.67) = 28,916.67. The page gives no rent figure and refers to Sophia's housing list, so housing = Sophia Soshigaya International House, the university-run option on the Spring/Autumn 2026 Housing List Summary (piloti.sophia.ac.jp/assets/uploads/2026/02/26A_Housing-List-Summary_202602.pdf): 605,500 for one year (10 months) = 60,550/month, utilities included (about 60 minutes from campus; options nearer campus on the same list run roughly 87,500-130,000/month). This is close to the JASSO 2023 survey average rent in Tokyo of 57,000. Excluded: Personal Accident Insurance for Students 800/year, tuition, flights and set-up costs.

programmes.name: Faculty of Liberal Arts (English-taught)
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for 2026 entrants; compulsory fees are enrollment and education enhancement fees. The one-off is the ¥200,000 entrance fee. Taught in English.
programmes.notes: AY 2026 undergraduate fee table, 2026-entrant column: semester enrollment fee ¥30,000 + tuition ¥586,000 + education enhancement fee ¥105,000 per semester, so tuition ¥1,172,000/yr and compulsory fees ¥270,000/yr. Entrance fee ¥200,000 once. The 2026-entrant spring semester carries an education enhancement fee of ¥129,000 instead of ¥105,000, so the extra ¥24,000 is added to the one-off amount (annual total ¥1,668,650 including the entrance fee and insurance). Personal accident insurance (¥2,650 at entry) and the ¥40,000 alumni association fee in year 4 are excluded. The AY 2026 table charges continuing 2024-25 entrants the same higher rate as 2026 entrants, so fees rise during study; not cohort-locked. 2025 row from the AY 2025 table, 2025-entrant column: tuition ¥1,142,000/yr (¥571,000 per semester), enhancement ¥105,000 per semester. English-taught. 2024 row from the AY 2024 undergraduate fee table in Sophia University Newsletter (上智大学通信) No. 472, October 2023, 2024-entrant column (the one with the ¥200,000 entrance fee and ¥2,650 insurance): per semester enrollment ¥30,000, tuition ¥556,000, enhancement ¥129,000 spring / ¥105,000 fall (orientation ¥24,000 in the one-off); read 2026-10-13.
